# Silverline Engineering Limited

> Leading Zambian-owned engineering and construction firm delivering turnkey Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, and Solar Energy solutions for commercial, industrial, institutional, and infrastructure developments.

## Overview
Silverline Engineering Limited is a registered Zambian multidisciplinary engineering and construction contractor operating across Zambia and Southern Africa. Headquartered with facilities in Lusaka and Kitwe (Copperbelt), the company provides complete EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) and general contracting services with a strong focus on precision, safety, and timely delivery.

- **Website**: https://silverline-engineering.com
- **Inquiries & General Email**: info@silverlineng.com
- **Phone Numbers**: +260 966 626579 / +260 771 814040 / +260 977 467664
- **Lusaka Office**: Plot 397a/40/d Off Kafue Road, Makeni, Lusaka, Zambia
- **Kitwe Office**: Stand No. 1204, Light Industrial Area, Kitwe, Zambia
- **Operational Hours**: Monday – Friday: 08:00 – 17:00 CAT

## Core Engineering Disciplines & Services
- [Civil & Structural Engineering](https://silverline-engineering.com/#services): Heavy reinforced concrete foundations, structural steel framing, commercial retail buildings, industrial warehouses, earthworks, site leveling, stormwater drainage, and road paving.
- [Electrical Engineering](https://silverline-engineering.com/#services): High, medium, and low voltage reticulation, transformer substations, industrial power distribution, MCC panel building, switchgear, backup power integration, and building automation.
- [Mechanical Engineering](https://silverline-engineering.com/#services): Industrial piping and fluid transport, HVAC ventilation systems, pumping stations, steel structure prefabrication, machinery installations, and plant maintenance.
- [Solar & Renewable Energy](https://silverline-engineering.com/#services): Turnkey commercial and industrial (C&I) rooftop solar, ground-mounted photovoltaic plants, battery energy storage systems (BESS), solar water pumping, and mini-grids.
- [Fabrication & Industrial Capabilities](https://silverline-engineering.com/#capabilities): Dedicated 5,000m² fabrication workshop in Kitwe, CNC plasma cutting machines, heavy mobile cranes, earthmoving equipment, and certified welders.

## Landmark Projects & Case Studies
- [East Park Mall Expansion](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/east-park-mall-expansion): Structural steel additions, reinforced concrete suspended slabs, and modern retail infrastructure for Napoli Property in Lusaka, delivered safely in a live, high-traffic commercial mall.
- [MECO Milling Plant](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/meco-milling-plant): Heavy industrial agro-processing facility featuring reinforced concrete grain silos, structural machinery bays, and automated electrical integration.
- [UNDP Bulking Centers](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/undp-bulking-centers): Institutional agricultural aggregation warehouses, civil grading, and renewable infrastructure developed for the United Nations Development Programme in Zambia.
- [Ndeke Mosque](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/ndeke-mosque): Iconic architectural and communal religious development with complex dome engineering and specialized finishes.
- [Oryx Munali Filling Station](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/oryx-munali-filling-station): Turnkey petroleum service station including canopy fabrication, underground storage tank civil works, forecourt paving, and hazardous-area electrical wiring.
- [Alix Investment Factory](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/alix-investment-factory): Large-span pre-engineered steel warehouse and manufacturing floor for industrial production.
- [Eco Petroleum Chalala](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/eco-petroleum-chalala): Complete service station construction, retail convenience building, forecourt, and underground fuel infrastructure.
- [Limulunga Day Secondary School](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/limulunga-day-secondary-school): Educational campus blocks, science laboratories, administration offices, and sanitation facilities in Western Province.
- [Afro Oil Filling Station](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/afro-oil-filling-station): Fuel retail forecourt, civil pavement, structural canopy, and pump connections.
- [Victoria Falls Road Rehabilitation](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/victoria-falls-road): Civil infrastructure, road resurfacing, earthmoving, culverts, and stormwater drainage.
- [ENGIC Solar Plants](https://silverline-engineering.com/projects/engic-solar-plants): Commercial solar PV installations, inverter integration, and renewable power delivery.

## Key Statutory Accreditations
- **National Council for Construction (NCC)**: Certified general building and civil engineering contractor.
- **Engineering Institution of Zambia (EIZ)**: Certified corporate and practicing engineering firm.
- **Energy Regulation Board (ERB)**: Licensed renewable energy and fuel infrastructure contractor.
- **ZPPA Registered**: Qualified for public and institutional tenders.
